bh.brief.task.title: 1. THE JOB
bh.brief.task.body: Find the VHS tape. It hisses, follow the sound.|Carry it to the exit behind your spawn and stand there for 3 seconds.|You also take the round when nobody from the other squad is left alive.|Whoever carries the tape can be heard. A dead carrier drops it on the spot.
bh.brief.match.title: 2. THE MATCH
bh.brief.match.body: The match goes to 5 wins.|A round lasts 3 minutes. For the first 10 seconds the squad holds still.|Time runs out with the tape still inside: the squad with more people alive wins.|Every 3 rounds the squads swap sides.|The world host starts the match: the REC console by the briefing table, or /bh start.
bh.brief.gear.title: 3. GEAR
bh.brief.gear.body: At the start of every round: your squad's pistol, ammo for 2 magazines, a flashlight, a bandage.|You carry 20 things. TAB opens your gear, G drops what is in your hand.|Find the rest inside: ammo, bandages, batteries, sometimes a gun.|Gear is handed out fresh every round.
bh.brief.light.title: 4. LIGHT
bh.brief.light.body: Flashlight: T. The battery does not last. An empty one recharges by itself, but only to 15%%.|Spare battery: hold it, RMB.|A breaker cuts the light around it, the generator cuts it in the whole building. Then only the red emergency lamps glow.|Breaker and generator: RMB or F. They are loud, whoever touches them gives himself away.
bh.brief.fear.title: 5. FEAR AND WOUNDS
bh.brief.fear.body: Darkness and wounds frighten you. Fear builds up by itself, you hear it in your heartbeat.|The stronger the fear, the worse: shaking hands, sounds that are not there.|Light nearby and bandaging calm you down.|Bandage: hold RMB for 2 seconds. You cannot shoot while bandaging.
bh.brief.noise.title: 6. NOISE
bh.brief.noise.body: Running, gunshots, glass and metal underfoot, jumps and falls carry far.|Walking is quieter. Crouching is quieter still, but a crouched landing is heard too.|Crouched, an edge holds you for half a second, then you slip off.|There are ways down from the 2nd floor: the canopy over the entrance, the passage roof, broken windows above the dumpsters. Down only, and noisy.
bh.brief.comms.title: 7. COMMS AND KEYS
bh.brief.comms.body: Voices carry only nearby.|Radio: hold Z. The whole squad hears it, wherever they are.|Voice setup: key 0.|Lean: Q and E. Reload: R. Melee: V. Breaker, generator and the tape with a gun in hand: F.
bh.brief.death.title: 8. IF YOU ARE KILLED
bh.brief.death.body: Your camera goes dark.|From then on you watch through a living teammate's camera. LMB and RMB switch cameras.|Next round you are back in.
bh.brief.note.task_a: It hisses loud. You hear it, so do they.
bh.brief.note.match_a: 3 minutes is long. Especially the last one.
bh.brief.note.light_a: It's calmer where the lamps are on. Don't know why.
bh.brief.note.light_b: The dark is not just dark.
bh.brief.note.fear_a: The voices don't answer. Don't answer them either.
bh.brief.note.noise_a: Don't run. Everything is heard in there.
bh.brief.note.comms_a: If the radio is quiet too long, call. No answer, don't go there alone.
bh.brief.note.death_a: Watch closely. The cameras see more than we do.
bh.brief.note.missing_a: We are not alone in there.
bh.brief.note.missing_b: Don't go one by one. Seryoga went alone.
bh.brief.note.missing_c: A shot scared it off. Not for long.
bh.brief.note.missing_d: If it goes quiet, that's bad.
